name: the hand-made deletion fires no input event
why: A bare .value write is invisible to the filter: the box empties and the table stays filtered on the old text (the source-row-tally-memo flake).

name: a selection past the prefix is blocked like a caret
why: The pre-2026-10-02 Backspace rule: any Backspace starting at or before the boundary was blocked, so Ctrl+A then Backspace did nothing.
